study type: Prospective observational study with cross-sectional analysis at admission
outcome: Microbial invasion of the amniotic cavity (MIAC)
cohort: One hundred women with singleton pregnancies complicated by preterm prelabor rupture of membranes (PPROM) between the gestational ages of 24+0 and 36+6 weeks were included in the study.
finding: In women with PPROM, cervical HPV infection at admission was not related to a higher risk of intra-amniotic infection-related and inflammatory complications or worse short-term neonatal outcomes.
